# Design & Proof Gate — summary (generated by `report.php`; do not edit by hand)

Every number below is read from `results/actual/*.jsonl` produced by `run.sh`. `S0` = unpatched repository runtime; `EQN`, `EQW`, `EQL`, `EQV` = isolated experimental runtimes (baseline + `patches/eq-candidates.patch`). **None of this is production code or an approved policy.**

## 1. Variants

| Variant | Definition (as implemented in the patch) |
|---|---|
| S0 | Unpatched `EvaluationPipeline` at the pinned baseline. |
| EQN | *Rejected ablation.* Detection **and** enforcement only on policy-scored commands (a reported failure, or access scoring); nothing is observed or enforced at `checkOnly`. |
| EQW | *Alternative.* S0 detection on every command, unchanged. Enforcement only with **fresh scored evidence** (a fixed 60 s WATCH marker written by a scored command) in the detection scope — for every rule including the LOW (UA-only) dilution. |
| **EQL** | **Base design under evaluation (not adopted).** EQW, except that the LOW-confidence (UA-only) cross-IP dilution is **advisory**: no state is written and nothing is enforced. |
| EQV | *Bounded alternative for the API_OVERUSE shortfall.* EQL, except that for access-scored policies a call is evidence only when the K2/K3 volume score reaches the near-threshold level (L1 - 1) that §5.0 already uses for WATCH. |
